question: Does adding one family-invariant latent-phase landmark to the otherwise unchanged exhaustive R4 immediate-context support make all nine entities identifiable without splitting their three raw surface aliases?
hypothesis: R4's sole cross-entity collision is caused by phase symmetry in the unanchored sixteen-context support. Prefixing each context tuple with the shared landmark byte 160 + context_index will break that symmetry, inducing exactly nine correct three-member alias classes and zero cross-entity collision pairs, while an unanchored R4 replication control remains at eight classes and one collision pair.

prior_evidence.observation: Complete sixteen-context support induced eight classes, nine correct alias triplets, seven isolated three-member classes, and exactly one cross-entity collision pair; the matched sampled control retained nine classes and zero collisions.

scope_statement: This is one bounded representation diagnostic. It adds exactly one family-invariant phase byte to each exhaustive R4 context signature. Surface motifs, entity and family cardinalities, the sixteen R4 contexts, record count, exact support equality, and evaluator-only semantic audit remain fixed. It does not train a task model or claim language competence.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, or live-interface authority

arms_and_inputs.phase_anchored_support_arm: For each of nine entities and three families, emit every R4 context_index 0..15 exactly once. Induce classes by exact sorted support of five-byte tuples [160 + context_index, prefix0, prefix1, suffix0, suffix1].
arms_and_inputs.unanchored_r4_replication_control: The exact R4 exhaustive bridge and four-byte support inducer, required to reproduce eight classes, nine correct alias triplets, seven three-member classes, and one cross-entity collision pair.
arms_and_inputs.seeds: No sampling seed is used. R4's deterministic noise state remains byte-identical and is excluded from signatures.
arms_and_inputs.evaluation: Deterministic class/cardinality and evaluator-only entity-membership audit; no task model is trained.

representation_and_measurement.surface_selection: The same twenty-seven raw four-byte motifs selected from the frozen R4 matched bridge, occurrence count descending then lexicographic raw key.
representation_and_measurement.anchored_signature: Complete sorted set of five-byte context tuples with the phase landmark first; equality is exact and count magnitudes are absent.
representation_and_measurement.control_signature: The unchanged R4 complete sorted set of four-byte immediate-context tuples.
representation_and_measurement.identifiability_audit: Count induced classes, three-member classes, correct same-entity alias triplets, and unordered distinct-entity pairs whose surfaces share a class.
representation_and_measurement.semantic_scoring: Entity and family identity are used only after class induction to audit membership and collisions.

controls: The unanchored R4 control must reproduce 432 records, sixteen records and contexts per surface, eight classes, seven three-member classes, nine correct alias triplets, and exactly one cross-entity collision pair.
The anchored arm differs from the control signature only by the phase_anchor coordinate; all R4 prefix, suffix, motif, noise, ordering, and cardinality formulas remain unchanged.
For every entity and family, each anchor byte 160..175 appears exactly once and each five-byte anchored context is distinct.
All twenty-seven selected representations must equal the frozen true surface motifs.
Class induction receives no family label, entity label, semantic label, alias dictionary, tokenizer, task transition, external model, approximate matching, distance threshold, or oracle correction.
validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.
The frozen R4 probe reproduces its exact exhaustive cardinalities and class/collision result before any R5 scientific output is emitted.
Every surface contributes exactly one observation for each context_index and anchor byte 160..175.
The anchored representation adds only phase_anchor to the unchanged R4 four-byte context tuple.
Surface selection is obtained from the frozen R4 matched bridge and matches all twenty-seven true motifs.
Entity and family identity are unavailable to induction and enter only the post-induction audit.
All 36 unordered entity pairs are audited exactly once.
All metrics are finite and full Go regression passes before the probe.
No task training, tokenizer, external model, network call, capacity growth, approximate matching, threshold change, or adaptive evaluation occurs.

classification_rules.phase_anchor_identifiability_supported: Validity and controls pass; anchored support induces exactly nine correct three-member classes and zero distinct-entity collision pairs.
classification_rules.phase_anchor_identifiability_falsified: Validity and controls pass; anchored support has fewer than nine classes, any incorrect or split alias triplet, or any distinct-entity collision pair.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity and controls pass, but anchored results satisfy neither supported nor falsified rule.
classification_rules.negative_control_failure: The unanchored R4 control fails any frozen exact cardinality.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents the frozen matrix.
classification_rules.invalid: Any identity, construction, phase-anchor, representation, leakage, evaluator-boundary, determinism, finite-metric, or qualification criterion fails.

stop_conditions: Stop invalid before science on parent, North Star, R4 replication, exhaustive cardinality, phase-anchor construction, build, or frozen-package drift.
After R5 output begins, complete all 432 anchored observations and all 36 entity-pair audits unless infrastructure prevents it.
Do not alter formulas, coordinates, representation, controls, metrics, thresholds, budgets, capacities, or classification after observing R5 output.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: No input formula, phase coordinate, context cardinality, representation rule, audit, control, metric, threshold, budget, capacity, or interpretation may change after primary R5 output.
